spec.overlap_measurement: Per-gesture actual swept physical-nib occupancy at 180 DPI. Intersection and union pixels record repeated coverage independently of centerline crossings. Require attribution to declared contributor pairs. Boundary segments belong to both adjacent gestures. Darkness/ink-depletion effects are not simulated or accepted.
